PATNA HIGH COURT
NOTICE
With regard to filling up of the vacancies in the cadre of Civil Judge
(Senior Division) for the year 2023-24.
This is for information that the Court have been pleased to direct to ask for list of
contested judgement (Civil & Criminal) delivered during the period from 2019 to 2023 from all
the eligible officers who have completed 5 years of qualifying service by 31.03.2024 and are
confirmed in service as Civil Judge (Junior Division) except those who have since
retired/compulsory retired/dismissed under recommendation of promotion, for consideration of
their cases for promotion to the cadre of Civil Judge (Senior Division) for the year 2023-24. The
names of such officers are as under:

The aforenamed officers have to send their list of contested judgments within a fortnight
from the date of communication from this Court through the Principal District & Sessions Judges
concerned in the prescribed proforma annnexed herewith.
The officers must ensure that the list of judgments they will be furnishing/submitting
must be of contested judgments only and they must keep the judgments in readiness so that
they may be in a position to send them on a short notice.
Patna High Court, Patna.
